title: FlowShowOutput
description: Output of `gentry flow show --json`: the active flow of the project with its texts, or with --draft the draft: the flow directory with its changes, in any directory. Also the output of `gentry task flow show --json`: the flow of the task, the snapshot it was taken with; then task is present, and applied, dir and draft are absent. With an object flag the arrays narrow to the object and what it refers to: for a scenario its stages, their parts and subagents; for a stage its parts and subagent; for a part or a subagent the object alone.

task.title: FlowShowTask
task.description: The task whose flow is shown: the flow of the task, the snapshot it was taken with, which it follows to its end; present only in `gentry task flow show`.

id.description: Identifier of the task, such as SHOP-1.

flow.description: The commit that applied the flow of the task, as flow of the task in `gentry task show --json`.

active_flow.description: The last change of the active flow: the later of the commits that applied the flow of the project and the shared subagents. Present only if the active flow changed after the task was taken: the flow a task taken now would get differs from the flow of the task in a scenario, stage, part, subagent of the project, shared subagent its stages name or the common rules; line ends alone do not count.

applied.description: The commit that applied the active flow; absent if the project has no flow yet, which only the draft can show, and when the flow of a task is shown.

dir.description: Absolute path of the flow directory: the active flow and the draft over it; absent when the flow of a task is shown.

draft.title: FlowDraftInfo
draft.description: The draft of the flow: present if the flow directory differs from the active flow; absent when the flow of a task is shown.

conflict_dir.description: Absolute path of the directory with the variants of another machine; present only while the flow is in conflict.

conflicts.description: Objects whose variants of another machine are in conflict_dir, in the order of a diff; present only while the flow is in conflict.

object.description: Kind of the object: common for the common rules of the flow, scenario, stage, part or agent for a subagent of the project.

id.description: Identifier of the object; absent for the common rules.

sync.description: What the synchronization before the command did; present only when there is something to tell.

id.description: Identifier of the scenario, the name of its file.

title.description: Name of the scenario shown to the operator.

nodes.description: Nodes of the scenario graph in the order of the scenario file.

id.description: Identifier of the node, unique within the scenario. One stage may stand in several nodes.

stage.description: Identifier of the stage of the node.

next.description: Transitions from the node, always a list, even when the scenario file has one node identifier. At most one is without a condition: the default path.

to.description: Identifier of the target node, or finish for the end of the scenario.

if.description: Condition of the transition as text, evaluated by the agent; absent for the transition of the default path.

max_rounds.description: Limit of rounds of the loop the transition closes; absent when the transition closes no loop.

id.description: Identifier of the stage, the name of its files.

title.description: Name of the stage shown to the operator.

exit.description: Exit of the stage: what must be true to close it.

executor.description: Who carries out the stage: orchestrator for the main agent session, operator for the operator, otherwise the identifier of a subagent of the project or of a shared subagent.

include.description: Identifiers of the parts included in the instruction of the stage, in the order of the stage file; empty if none.

checks.description: Commands of checks Gentry runs in the worktree of the task when the stage is closed by an exit, in the order of the stage file; absent if the stage has none.

timeout.description: Time all the commands of checks have together, as the flow writes it: whole numbers with the units h, m and s, such as 90s or 1h30m; 10m if the stage file does not give it. Present only with checks.

instruction.description: Instruction of the stage in markdown, as written.

id.description: Identifier of the part, the name of its file.

text.description: Text of the part in markdown, as written.

agents.description: Subagents by identifier: those of the project and the shared subagents the stages name. A project subagent replaces a shared one of the same identifier.

id.description: Identifier of the subagent, the name of its files.

source.description: Where the subagent comes from: project for a subagent of the flow, shared for a shared subagent.

capabilities.description: What the subagent may do, in the order of its file.

model.description: Model level of the subagent; absent if the flow does not name one, and the subagent runs on the model of the main session.

instruction.description: Instruction of the subagent in markdown, as written.
